title: SB0855 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 10-7-504; Section 33-6-413; Section 38-8-116; Title 39; Title 40; Title 49; Title 50; Section 58-1-112 and Title 70, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2021-02-10; own version, official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514165815 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/112/Bill/SB0855.pdf; the last listed version was not archived)
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2021-02-10. The state summary says the bill broadens who may carry handguns in a public park; the text read only edits 39-17-1309(e)(8). The last listed version was not archived, and a later version could differ.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(8)(A)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1309(e)(8)(A), is amended by deleting the language "§ 39-17-1351" and substituting instead the language "§ 39-17-1351 or § 39-17-1366".
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(8)(B)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1309(e)(8)(B), is amended by deleting the language "enhanced".
